text:
Maia Patel: hey team, customer FinSight sent a security questionnaire that asks for details on RBAC change audit trails, KMS key usage (envelope keys vs service keys), and our vuln/incident escalation timelines. They want concrete evidence and an export for the last 90 days. can we collate what we can provide and any gaps?

Derek Chen: short answers up front — we have immutable audit logs for RBAC changes, key rotation records for envelope keys, and a 2-tier incident SLA for P1/P2. need to confirm retention window and exact fields they want in export.

Maia Patel: they specifically asked for: who changed role bindings, old/new roles, timestamp, source IP, and request ID. also they want proof of KMS usage per-tenant (which key encrypted which envelope).

Jen Ortiz: for Dedicated vs Hosted the metadata differs. Hosted (our API) logs include request_id + principal_id + role_delta but we don't persist source IP for internal control-plane operations by default — need to check GCP/azure sidecar logging. Dedicated customers running in their VPC will have their own egress IPs; we can provide our service's control-plane IPs.

Samir Rao: KMS flow recap: we use envelope encryption. Model payloads encrypted with a data key (DEK), which is wrapped by a KMS CMK per-customer (KEK). KMS audit record shows Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey usage. we can map DEK IDs to CMK via the enveloping metadata in object store. we'll need to join object-store metadata + kms audit logs.

Maia Patel: ok can you outline an export pipeline? DLL customer will accept csv + signed manifest.

Derek Chen: pipeline idea: 1) RBAC changes — query our audit-log index for event_type: role_change and fields [actor, timestamp, old_role, new_role, request_id, src_ip]. 2) KMS usage — pull KMS audit logs from cloud (Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey) filter by resource name = customer_cmk. 3) Correlate object-store metadata (object_id -> dek_id) to KMS logs -> produce mapping. 4) produce CSVs and a small JSON manifest signed by our infra key.

Maia Patel: sample query we can run?

Derek Chen: example (elastic):
```
GET /audit-*/_search
{
  "query": {
    "bool": {
      "must": [
        {"term": {"event_type": "role_change"}},
        {"range": {"@timestamp": {"gte": "now-90d"}}},
        {"term": {"tenant_id.keyword": "finsight-tenant-id"}}
      ]
    }
  },
  "_source": ["actor","@timestamp","old_role","new_role","request_id","src_ip"]
}
```
Samir Rao: KMS logs (GCP example) — cloud audit entries contain methodName: "Encrypt"/"Decrypt" and resourceName = projects/*/locations/*/keyRings/*/cryptoKeys/<cmk>. We'll export BigQuery or pubsub sink for the 90d window. join on timestamp/DEK id.

Maia Patel: what about redaction and sensitive fields? customer wants principals (emails) but we must not include any secrets or PII beyond what's required. our export should redact tokens, and we should hash any session ids not requested.

Jen Ortiz: agree. also confirm legal for sharing source IPs for hosted control-plane requests — may need customer NDA addendum. pinged legal.

sec-bot: automated-notice: vuln scan found 1 medium CVE in dependency: libhttpx 2.7.1 — assigned to eng-runtime, ticket #RNW-4782.

Maia Patel: noted — unrelated to export but include mention of ongoing triage in the assurance packet. what about evidence for key rotation events? they asked for rotation timestamps + who triggered.

Samir Rao: we have rotation metadata in KMS audit (SetPrimary / update) plus our internal key-management service writes a rotation event to audit log with actor=system or actor=user-id. can extract both sources and correlate.

Derek Chen: if we produce the CSVs, let's include columns: event_type, timestamp, actor, target_resource, old_value, new_value, request_id, src_ip, evidence_refs. For KMS: operation, cmk_resource, dek_id, object_id, timestamp, request_id.

Maia Patel: timeline? FinSight needs the bundle in 5 business days. can we commit?

Jen Ortiz: I'll scope the Hosted export today (2p EST) and validate fields. Dedicated will need extra work — Samir, estimate for KMS join for both Hosted + Dedicated?

Samir Rao: Hosted path (control plane logs + cloud KMS exports) — 1.5 days to prototype join and generate demo CSV. Dedicated path — 2.5 days because metadata lives in customer-specific object stores and we need per-tenant connectors. total ~3 days with Derek producing RBAC export in parallel.

Derek Chen: I'll produce the RBAC change export script and a sample CSV format by EOD today.

Maia Patel: great. Jen, make legal follow-up note and check IP sharing. I'll draft the cover letter and the signed manifest template.

Oncall Bot: IR note: for any P1/P2 evidence requests, follow the incident evidence playbook -> /runbooks/ir/evidence. If a customer requests logs beyond standard retention, we escalate to SecOps (secops@redwood) for extension request.

Maia Patel: one last ask from FinSight — they asked whether we can provide upstream SIEM snapshots (CEF) for ingestion. is that doable?

Samir Rao: we can export CEF from our SIEM (Splunk) but there are licensing & volume costs. will need product approval. propose offering a one-time export (90d) as part of the assurance pack and outline ongoing export as a paid add-on.

Jen Ortiz: noted. tagging @product for pricing.

Maia Patel: thanks everyone. action items: Derek = rb/role export script + sample csv (EOD), Samir = kms join prototype (1.5d) + dedicated plan (2.5d), Jen = legal/IP check + product pricing ask, Maia = draft cover letter + signed manifest. I'll assemble and run QA before sending to FinSight. :thumbsup: 

Derek Chen: ack.

Samir Rao: ack.

sec-bot: reminder: please link RNW-4782 in the assurance packet under "Known Issues".

Maia Patel: will do.

Jen Ortiz: bumping — please drop updates here as you progress.
